compliance_time_text: Groups 1 and 2: within the next 100 hours TIS or within the next 12 months after March 6, 2008, whichever occurs first (retained from AD 2008-03-02). Groups 3 and 4: within the next 100 hours TIS or within the next 12 months after March 13, 2012, whichever occurs first.
unsafe_condition_summary: Chafing of the fuel return line assembly could cause fuel leaks and fuel vapours, which could lead to fire.

out_of_scope_features.feature: part number: fuel return line assembly P/N 0500118-49
out_of_scope_features.quote: fuel return line assembly (Cessna part number (P/N) 0500118-49) for chafing

effective_date: This airworthiness directive (AD) is effective March 13, 2012.
supersedes: This AD supersedes AD 2008-03-02, Amendment 39-15351 (73 FR 5737, January 31, 2008).
compliance_time_text: (1) For Group 1 and Group 2 Airplanes: Within the next 100 hours time-in-service (TIS) after March 6, 2008 (the effective date retained from AD 2008-03-02) or within the next 12 months after March 6, 2008 (the effective date retained from AD 2008-03-02), whichever occurs first, inspect the fuel return line assembly (Cessna part number (P/N) 0500118-49) for chafing.

(2) For Group 3 and Group 4 Airplanes: Within the next 100 hours TIS after March 13, 2012 (the effective date of this AD) or within the next 12 months after March 13, 2012 (the effective date of this AD), whichever occurs first, inspect the fuel return line assembly (Cessna P/N 0500118-49) for chafing.
unsafe_condition_summary: Chafing of the fuel return line assembly could result in fuel leaking and fuel vapors, which could lead to fire.
